title: Jersey Mike's CEO谈上市首日表现与供应链需求增长
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I am here with the Jersey Mike CEO Charlie Morrison Charlie. Thanks for doing congratulations on listening today. Thank you. It's a great day for Jersey Mike. I have to say I don't envy any CEO that has to list in this crazy market.
segments.zh: 今天请到Jersey Mike's CEO查理·莫里森。查理，恭喜上市。谢谢，对Jersey Mike来说是重要的一天。说实话，我不羡慕任何要在当前动荡市场上市的CEO。

segments.en: We're living right now has been quite volatile and especially for a lot of your peers. I mean sweet green down 4% shake shack down 24% year-to-date wingstop.
segments.zh: 市场波动很大，尤其对比同行：Sweetgreen跌4%，Shake Shack年内跌24%，Wingstop跌44%。

segments.en: Also, which you once led down 44%. So why was amid all of that? Why was now the right time to IPO? I think it's a great time to IPO.
segments.zh: 为什么选择现在IPO？我认为时机很好。Jersey Mike's品牌积淀多年，有超过70年历史。

segments.en: Jersey Mike. This is a brand that's been built over many many years. We have a rich history of over 70 years. The last 20 years alone the only brand that can cite 20
segments.zh: 过去20年，我们是唯一实现连续20年同店销售正增长的品牌。多次穿越周期。

segments.en: consecutive years of positive same-store sales growth. We've been able to navigate the choppy waters over many many many times through our cycle.
segments.zh: 今年迄今同店销售继续增长，一季度到二季度环比改善。

segments.en: Even this year year-to-date same-store sales continue to grow.
segments.zh: 二季度末同店销售增长2.3%，主要由客流量驱动。

segments.en: We've seen sequential improvement from quarter one to quarter two.
segments.zh: 现在是上市的好时机，我们能应对挑战，着眼长期。

segments.en: Exiting quarter two at 2.3% same-store sales growth. Most of that driven by traffic.
segments.zh: 基本面良好，但有没有投行建议等待更平静的时机？完全没有，他们全力推进。

segments.en: So it's a great time to bring this brand to the market. We can deal with some of the challenges that are in there but really it's for the long-term.
segments.zh: 现在是把这个品牌推向市场的好时机。我们能应对一些挑战，但真正着眼的是长期。

segments.en: So the fundamentals look good heading into this but was there ever a banker that was thinking hey Charlie maybe now is not the time maybe we need to wait for calmer waters? Not at all. They take me full steam ahead.
segments.zh: 基本面看起来不错，但有没有银行家想过，查理，现在可能不是时候，也许该等风平浪静？完全没有。他们让我全速前进。

segments.en: Yeah this is a brand that's really well built for the public markets. What about the pricing? Because shares have fallen initially down 8.7% that they've come back of course now down only about 4%.
segments.zh: 这个品牌确实很适合公开市场。定价方面呢？股价最初下跌8.7%，现在回升至仅跌约4%。

segments.en: What do you think of the pricing? Was the pricing off perhaps and that's why we're falling. Today may be valuations a little bit too pricey rich to richly priced rather? No I don't think it has anything to do with the price and I think
segments.zh: 您怎么看定价？是否定价有误导致下跌？或者估值过高？不，我认为这与定价无关，

segments.en: a market's been a little choppy over the last few days trying to find its place.
segments.zh: 市场最近几天有些波动，正在寻找方向。
